name: Yuuto Nakajima
source:
"Chaotic" is the best word to describe Yuuto Nakajima, a talented member of the volleyball club. Full of boundless energy, Yuuto is the life of the party - as far as he knows. He is compassionate and empathetic to everyone and everything about him, despite his wild and blockheaded nature. After joining Jock Studio, Yuuto's more than happy and determined to show what he's made of!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]BLits[/url]]
